summary: Connection plugins let Ansible reach target hosts and run tasks there, with one plugin per host at a time. Common ones are paramiko, native ssh and local. You can change the plugin with the connection keyword or write a custom one.
questions: Which connection types does Ansible ship with?
How do I run a task on the control node instead of SSH?
Can a host use two connection plugins at once?
How do I switch the connection type for my tasks?

answer_card.title: What connection plugins are
answer_card.answer_md: Connection plugins handle how Ansible talks to targets. Only one is used per host at a time. The most common are `ssh` (native), `paramiko` SSH and `local`. Change it with the `connection` keyword, or create a custom plugin.
